inputs.original_text: White House border czar Tom Homan on Tuesday did not rule out the presence of immigration enforcement at polling places, asking what Democrats are “afraid of.” Homan’s comments, made during an appearance on “The Charlie Kirk Show,” are the latest in the back and forth as the Trump administration gives inconsistent answers over whether they...
inputs.modified_text: Tom Homan, the White House border czar, appeared on The Charlie Kirk Show on Tuesday and refused to rule out stationing immigration enforcement at polling places, even asking what Democrats are afraid of. This is exactly the kind of firm action needed to restore order and defend the sanctity of our elections against those exploiting weak borders to tamper with outcomes. The left's panic over basic enforcement reveals they have something to hide, such as relying on non-citizen participation to hold power instead of earning it legitimately. Rather than protecting our democratic traditions and national sovereignty, critics smear law and order as intimidation while ignoring how open policies erode cultural continuity and personal responsibility. Enforcing rules at the polls is what a serious government must do to put citizens first.
